name: Chromium 156 Cloud Browser in Your Browser
description: Full Chromium browser streamed to a tab, with a login and a saved profile.

PASSWORD.description: Browser login password, generated at deploy (copy it from this variable). Min 8 chars, 12+ recommended. Without a valid one the login stays locked.

CUSTOM_USER.description: Browser login name (letters, digits, . _ @ -). Invalid names fall back to 'chromium'.

PORT.description: Port of the web server (nginx). The public domain and the healthcheck use it. 3001 and 8082 are used internally.

TZ.description: Time zone that web pages see, e.g. Europe/Istanbul.

TITLE.description: Browser tab title of the streaming page.

CHROME_CLI.description: Optional. Start page and/or Chromium flags, space-separated, e.g. 'https://example.com --lang=de'. Applied after a redeploy.

RAILWAY_SHM_SIZE_BYTES.description: Shared memory (/dev/shm) for Chromium: 1 GiB. Railway's default is 64 MB; below 512 MiB Chromium falls back to /tmp.

APT_PACKAGES.description: Optional. Debian packages (space-separated) reinstalled in the background after every redeploy, e.g. 'fonts-noto-cjk'.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between stop signal and kill on redeploy, so Chromium can save its profile and shut down cleanly.
